notes: Summary: SaaS support knowledge-base vendor (multi-tenant) evaluating hosted Redwood API for embeddings + reranking pipeline.
Scale: ~6M doc chunks (50–100M embeddings precompute expected), indexing staged over 3 months; currently prototyping with 1.2M chunks.
Traffic / QPS: very high read QPS for KB lookup — 1k–3k qps at peak per region, 95th latency target < 120ms end-to-end for rerank flow.

Flow: user query -> dense embed -> ANN search (1st pass) -> rerank with cross-encoder (server-side) -> top-K answer assembly. Want Redwood to host both embed and rerank or at least embed + cheap rerank variants.
Latency constraints: cannot exceed 120ms for 1st pass & rerank combined in most cases; willing to trade slightly higher median for stable p95 SLA.
Cost sensitivity: per-query cost budget ~$0.003–0.008 at 95th qps after batching/caching; very sensitive to tokenized reranker costs on long contexts.
Model preferences: open models preferred for cost control (Llama-2 style 7B/13B for embeddings + rerank), but evaluating Redwood-verified variants; fallback to proprietary API only if cost/SLA ok.
Caching/batching: POC to test prefix caching + micro-batching to reduce tokens for rerank step; Redwood Optimize interest to suggest batching profiles.
Security / compliance: SSO/SAML required (enterprise customers), audit logs for all inference calls, KMS integration for key management, data residency (EU subset) for EU customers.
POC notes: running 2-week POC (pilot cluster) — indexed 1.2M chunks, ran simulated QPS 1k sustained; initial perf: avg end-to-end 160ms w/o aggressive batching; p95 spiked to 420ms under burst.
AE notes: customer expects cost projection scenarios for 1k/2k/3k qps with different model combos (7B + 13B rerank vs 13B only). Asked for sample cost calc by 2026-03-03.
SE notes: Maya ran custom perf job on 2026-02-10; attached perf deck. Observed KV cache hit improves p95 by ~30% for repeated queries.
Customer quote: 'We need predictable p95 and a clear per-query bill — surprises kill our unit economics.'
Legal: security questionnaire in progress; privacy team flagged multi-tenant isolation questions — docs linked in Drive.
Next: consolidate perf numbers + legal answers, propose SOW for Q2 pilot (3mo).
Short-term risks: if p95 cannot be brought below 250ms with hosted config, customer will insist on Dedicated evaluation or hybrid routing.
Action items: (1) SE to provide batched cost sims (2) Solutions to propose cross-encoder quantized reranker options (3) Legal to provide templatized Data Processing Addendum.
